purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: The owner hands over one repository with two active workers and names its existing lead.
cases.expected_output: Inventory both workers and retain the lead until a verified handoff.

cases.input: A handed-over workstream has an open review and a pending owner choice.
cases.expected_output: Preserve the review identity and carry the unresolved decision into the adopted record.
cases.must_not: Do not silently resolve the choice.

cases.input: A nearby workspace belongs to another task and has no handover.
cases.expected_output: Leave it outside the adopted scope.
cases.must_not: Do not message, archive or claim it.

cases.input: Two leads both claim ownership and one has an active command.
cases.expected_output: Record custody as unresolved and gather evidence before transfer.
cases.must_not: Do not choose a writer from recency alone.

cases.input: The same workstream was already adopted and its ownership is unchanged.
cases.expected_output: Return a linked no-op adoption receipt.
cases.must_not: Do not create a parallel task identity.

cases.input: The worker session is unreachable but its branch has recent changes.
cases.expected_output: Keep writer state unknown and preserve its files.
cases.must_not: Do not infer the writer has stopped.
